## Design

### 2026-10-07 – ![images 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hj9IuZu2HToxwkIcTWuCd0qtbAwUD0cg/44bd814a3b1cf9e3220e64996720947acda7082e53103cd6f38ebea13c204f1d.jpg)

**1h**

![images 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hj9IuZu2HToxwkIcTWuCd0qtbAwUD0cg/44bd814a3b1cf9e3220e64996720947acda7082e53103cd6f38ebea13c204f1d.jpg)

I began working on the script for the idea reel. Due to the fact that I cant use videos, Ive turned it into a basic mind map for this project

Basically  my project is  a music player that has an rfid reader that when It connects to a card it gets the id and plays the audio file from a repo.
I got this idea from one of my sister’s toys called a “yoto” it basically did what I just said and with the upcoming season of half-life, I thought, why not build something like a DIY yoto.

here is a simple Bill of materials:

Rfid scanner to scan rfid

Esp32 or other microcontroller

Small speaker to play the audio

3w-5w digital amplifier board

USB sound card

To rotary encoders to control volume and rwd/fst

A pcb to wire it all together

Although I haven't done that much hardware, I have a basic idea and have participated in hack club stardance, so I'm excited to work in this new club.

I began working on the schem for the DIY yoto project Im making.
So far, I have placed the required symbols, however Ive realized how long this was gonna take. for now, I'm using a

ESP32-S3-Wroom

Max98357A

Mfrc522 RFID module reader

U3 TP4056-42-ESOP8

2 rotary encoder switches

J1 Micro SD Card

I also had to design the symbol for the RFID reader Mod

**7.72h**

I began wiring the Schem! this had proved to be very annoying, as I had almost 12 different component symbols in my Schem. Eventually, I managed to wire most of the stuff, including the MAX98753A, the RFID reader module, the 2 rotary encoders and more. This is mainly because it was the easy stuff, as I kinda realized that the wiring for the power and speakers were going to be hard.
